This breaks error-handling Rule 3 / Iron Law 1: a catch that only logs, after which the caller acts as if the write succeeded. The comment-free catch gives no reason for a fallback. A review or flow journal then attaches a missing file. Fix: drop the try/catch, or rethrow with context and `cause` (`cannot write runs export to ${file}`).
